paper.title_en: Signatures of charged rotating regular black holes: quasinormal modes, grey-body factors and shadows
paper.abstract_en: We construct and study possible astrophysical signatures of the rotating counterparts of two charged regular black holes, namely the Ayón--Beato--García (ABG) and Balart--Panotopoulos--Rincón (BPR) spacetimes -- obtained using the Newman-Janis algorithm. After verifying the regularity of the rotating metrics, we study massless scalar perturbations, compute the quasinormal mode (QNM) spectra, and characterise their dependence on the spin and charge parameters. Grey-body factors (GBFs) are computed, and the QNM-GBF correspondence is verified. The low-frequency superradiant amplification factor is also examined via matched asymptotic expansions. The Lyapunov exponents are used to connect the eikonal QNM damping rate to photon-orbit instability. Additionally, from shadow profiles, we constrain the parameter space of rotating regular black holes using the Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) observations. Across all the probes, we find that the rotating BPR and Kerr--Newman black holes behave almost indistinguishably from one another, while the rotating ABG geometry exhibits distinct perturbative, scattering, and geometric properties, particularly at larger values of spin and charge. Our analysis indicates that differentiating between charged rotating regular black hole models may be possible using gravitational wave and shadow observations.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文构建并系统研究了带电转动正则黑洞（ABG与BPR）的可观测特征，涵盖准正规模、灰体因子、超辐射放大、Lyapunov指数与阴影，并用EHT观测约束参数空间，理论深度与方法多样性较好，主题属于引力理论基础范畴，值得进一步阅读。
decision.title_zh: 带电转动正则黑洞的特征：准正规模、灰体因子与阴影
decision.abstract_zh: 我们构建并研究了两个带电正则黑洞的转动对应体的可能天体物理特征，即Ayón--Beato--García（ABG）和Balart--Panotopoulos--Rincón（BPR）时空——通过Newman-Janis算法获得。在验证了转动度规的正则性之后，我们研究无质量标量扰动，计算准正规模（QNM）谱，并刻画它们对自旋和电荷参数的依赖。我们计算了灰体因子（GBF），并验证了QNM-GBF对应关系。还通过匹配渐近展开研究了低频超辐射放大因子。Lyapunov指数被用于将eikonal QNM阻尼率与光子轨道不稳定性联系起来。此外，根据阴影轮廓，我们利用事件视界望远镜（EHT）观测约束转动正则黑洞的参数空间。在所有探针中，我们发现转动BPR黑洞与Kerr--Newman黑洞彼此几乎不可区分，而转动ABG几何则表现出不同的微扰、散射和几何性质，尤其是在较大自旋和电荷值下。我们的分析表明，利用引力波和阴影观测或许能够区分带电转动正则黑洞模型。
